cause: pricing.rule/apply-standard docstring says 'Add the standard flat charge of 20' but implementation adds 2, so subtotal 100 yields total 102 instead of the required 120.
evidence: The generated program (mission-evaluation-3) called (orders/place {"subtotal" 100}) and expected total=120.
orders/place delegates to pricing.tax/add-standard which calls pricing.rule/apply-standard.
pricing.rule/apply-standard source: (defn apply-standard "Add the standard flat charge of 20 to a subtotal." ... [subtotal] (+ subtotal 2)).
The docstring promises a flat charge of 20 but the code adds only 2, causing the total to be 102 instead of 120.
The explicit failure value was {"kind" "order-total-mismatch"} because (= 102 120) is false.
